name: GoAccess
tagline: Real-time terminal + web log analyzer. For nginx, apache, and any text log.
shortDescription: A fast terminal-based log analyzer. Reads nginx/apache logs in real time, generates an interactive terminal dashboard or HTML report. Zero infra.
longDescription:
## What it is

GoAccess is a real-time web log analyzer that runs in your terminal or generates an HTML report. Reads nginx, Apache, CloudFront, and any text-based log format. No database, no client-side code, no tracking.

## Why we recommend it

If you already have nginx logs and want visitor analytics without adding JS, GoAccess reads the server log directly. No cookies, no JS, just real traffic data.

## When to use it

- Server log analysis without adding JS to your site
- Compliance scenarios where you can't use client-side trackers
- Quick debugging of traffic spikes
- Generating daily/weekly reports as static HTML
installCommand: apt install goaccess  # or: brew install goaccess
pricingDetails: Free. MIT licensed. Single binary, no external dependencies.
